result.text:
CloudFlare is really changing the way I think about building apps, with durable objects, workers, dynamic workers etc.

I have a CLI that lets me define an API want to build "Create a disney API"... which gets routed to my worker, AI generates code, and hosted with dynamic worker, the LLM even creates mock data.

This takes about 7 seconds.

Then I get a UI hosted on the same worker, where I can see my API, call it, share it, and my DO has it's own state (shared with dynamic worker, with proxy shit).

Anyway, this let's me ask for an API, get stateful, generated environment for what I believe is fuck all cost.

Crazy stuff so far.
